a: Patur. hatam, pekid vaakir. hacha, pekid vela akir.
Rabbi amme shera lemival battechilla beshabbat. amri leh rabbanan: veha la ketiva ketubbatah! amar lehu: atpesuha mittaltelin.
Rav zevid shera lemival battechilla beshabbat. ikka deamri: rav zevid gufeh beal battechilla beshabbat.
Rav yehuda shera lemival battechilla beyom tov. amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: la tema beyom tov dishre, ha beshabbat asir, dehu haddin daafillu beshabbat name shere, umaase shehaya kach haya.

Rav pappa mishshemeh derava amar: beyom tov shere, beshabbat asir. amar leh rav pappi lerav pappa: may dataych — mittoch shehuttera chabbura letzorech, huttera name shello letzorech? ella meatta, muttar laasot mugemar beyom tov, demittoch shehuttera haveara letzorech, huttera name shello letzorech!
Amar leh, alecha amar kera: "ach asher yeachel lechol nefesh" — davar hashshave lechol nefesh.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ella meatta, nizdammen lo tzevi beyom tov, hoil veeno shave lechol nefesh, hachi name daasir lemishchateh? amar leh: ana devar (ha)tzorech lechol nefesh kaamena, tzevi tzarich lechol nefesh hu.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi, hora rabbi yochanan betzayydan: asur livol battechilla bashshabbat. umi ikka horaa leissur?
In, vehatnan: horuha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot.
Vei name, ki ha detanya: chut hashshidra shennifsak berubbo, divre rabbi. rabbi yaakov omer: afillu nikkav. hora rabbi kerabbi yaakov. amar rav huna: en halacha kerabbi yaakov.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: amar rabbi avahu, shaal rabbi yishmael ben yaakov demin tzur et rabbi yochanan betzayydan, vaana shemai: mahu livol battechilla bashshabbat, vaamar leh: asur. vehilcheta: muttar livol battechilla bashshabbat.

Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: achat betula veachat almana teuna beracha. umi amar rav huna hachi? vehaamar rav huna: almana enah teuna beracha! la kashya: kan bevachur shennasa almana, kan bealmon shennasa almana.

Vealmon shennasa almana la? vehaamar rav nachman, amar li huna bar natan, tana: minnayin levirkat chatanim baasara — shenneemar: "vayyikkach asara anashim mizzikne hair vayyomer shevu fo vayyeshevu". uvoaz almon shennasa almana hava.
May "enah teuna beracha" deamar rav huna — enah teuna beracha kol shiva, aval yom echad teuna beracha.
Ella ha detanya: shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyyehe sameach immah shelosha yamim. bemay: i bevachur, haamrat shiva! i bealmon, haamrat yom echad?
Ibbaet ema: bealmon — yom echad livracha, ushelosha lesimcha. veibbaet ema: bevachur — shiva livracha, ushelosha lesimcha.
b: Metivi: mevarchin livtula shiva ulealmana yom echad. may lav, afillu almana shennisset levachur! lo, lealmon. aval levachur may, shiva? i hachi litne: mevarchin livtula shiva, ulealmana shennisset levachur shiva, ulealmana yom echad?
Milleta pesikta katane, delekka betula devatzra mishshiva, velekka almana devatzra miyyom echad.

Gufa, amar rav nachman: amar li huna bar natan, tana: minnayin levirkat chatanim baasara — shenneemar: "vayyikkach asara anashim mizzikne hair vayyomer shevu fo". verabbi avahu amar, mehacha: "bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael".

Verav nachman, behay kera derabbi avahu may daresh beh? mibbee leh lechidtanya, haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu ubbarim shebbime imman amru shira al hayyam — shenneemar: "bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael". veiddach? im ken, lema kera "mibbeten". may "mimmekor" — al iske mekor.
Verabbi avahu, behay kera derav nachman may daresh beh? hahu mibbee leh lemidrash: ammoni velo ammonit, moavi velo moavit. dei salka datach livracha, la saggi delav zekenim.

Veiddach: i salka datach lemidrash, la saggi delav asara! in — lefarsome milleta, uchedaamar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa: pok veayyti li be asra, veema lach beanpayyhu: hamezakke leubbar kana. vehilcheta — hamezakke leubbar lo kana.
Tanu rabbanan: mevarchin birkat chatanim bevet chatanim. rabbi yehuda omer: af bevet haerusin mevarchin otah.
Amar abbaye: uvihuda shanu, mippene shemmityayched immah.

Tanya iddach: mevarchin birkat chatanim bevet chatanim, uvirkat erusin bevet haerusin. birkat haerusin may mevarech? ravin bar rav adda verabba bar rav adda, tarvayyhu mishshemeh derav yehuda amri: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam, asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav, vetzivvanu al haarayot, veasar lanu et haarusot, vehittir lanu et hannesuot al yede chuppa vekiddushin". rav acha bereh derava mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav yehuda: "baruch atta Adonai, mekaddesh yisrael al yede chuppa vekiddushin".
Man dela chatem, midde dehave abbirkat perot veabbirkat mitzvot. uman dechatem, midde dehave akkiddusha.
Tanu rabbanan: mevarchin birkat chatanim baasara kol shiva. amar rav yehuda: vehu shebbau panim chadashot.
May mevarech? amar rav yehuda: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam,

a: Shehakkol bara lichvodo".
Veyotzer haadam".
Vaasher yatzar et haadam betzalmo, betzelem demut tavnito, vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad. baruch atta Adonai, yotzer haadam".
"Sos tasis vetagel haakara, bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha. baruch atta Adonai, mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha".
"Sammeach tesammach reim haahuvim, kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem, baruch atta Adonai, mesammeach chatan vechalla".

"Baruch atta Adonai, elohenu melech haolam, asher bara sason vesimcha, chatan vechalla, gila, rinna, ditza, chedva, ahava veachva veshalom vereut. mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvechutzot yerushalayim kol sason vekol simcha, kol chatan vekol kalla, kol mitzhalot chatanim mechuppatam unearim mimmishte neginatam, baruch atta Adonai, mesammeach chatan im hakkalla".
Levi ikkela leve rabbi behilluleh derabbi shimon bereh, barech chamesh. rav assi ikkela leve rav ashe behilluleh demar bereh, barech shet.
Lema beha kamippalgi: demar savar chada yetzira havay, umar savar shete yetzirot havay.

La, dechulle alma chada yetzira havay. mar savar batar machshava azlinan, umar savar batar maase azlinan. ki ha derav yehuda rame, ketiv: "vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo", uchetiv: "zachar unekeva beraam", ha ketzad? battechilla ala bemachshava livroot shenayim, ulevassof nivra echad.
Rav ashe ikkela leve rav kahana. yoma kamma barech kullehu, mikkan veelach i ikka panim chadashot — barech kullehu, vei la — apposhe simcha bealma hu, mevarech "shehassimcha bimono" vaasher bara".

Mishshiva vead sheloshim, ben amar lehu mechamat hillula, uven la amar lehu mechamat hillula — mevarech "shehassimcha bimono". mikkan veelach, i amar lehu mechamat hillula — mevarech "shehassimcha bimono", vei la — la.

Vechi amar lehu mechamat hillula, ad emat? amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: ad teresar yarche shatta. umeikkara meemat? amar rav pappa: mikki remu seare baasinta. ini? veha rav pappa iasak leabba mar bereh, uvarech mishsheat erusin! shane rav pappa, dahava teriach leh.

Ravina iasak leh livreh be rav chaviva, uvarech mishsheat erusin. amar: kim li begavvayyhu dela hadri behu. la istayyay milleta vehadri behu. rav tachlifa bar mareva ikkela levavel, barech shet arichata. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Rav chaviva ikkela leve mahola, barech "shehassimcha bimono". velet hilcheta kevoteh — mishshum ditridi deit leh tzaara leyanoka.

Amar rav nachman amar rav: chatanim min hamminyan, veen avelim min hamminyan. metivi: chatanim vaavelim min hamminyan! matnita ka ramet aleh derav? rav tanna hu, ufelig. ittemar, amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: chatanim min hamminyan, veen avelim min hamminyan. metivi: chatanim vaavelim min hamminyan!
b: Ki tanya hahi — bevirkat hammazon, ki kaamar rabbi yochanan — beshura.

Veella ha deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: mevarchim birkat chatanim baasara, vachatanim min hamminyan. uvirkat avelim baasara, veen avelim min hamminyan. beracha beshura mi ikka? ella ki kaamar rabbi yochanan birchava.

Veella ha deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: mevarchin birkat chatanim baasara kol shiva, vachatanim min hamminyan. uvirkat avelim baasara kol shiva, veen avelim min hamminyan. birkat rechava kol shiva mi ikka? mashkachat la befanim chadashot.

Ki ha derav chiyyay bar abba makre beneh deresh lakish hava, veamri la matni bereh deresh lakish hava. shechev leh yanoka. yoma kamma la azal legabbeh. limchar davreh lihuda bar nachmani meturegmaneh. amar leh: kum ema milleta kol kovel yanoka. petach vaamar: "vayyar Adonai vayyinatz mikkaas banav uvenotav", dor sheavot menaatzim lehakkadosh baruch hu — koes al benehem veal benotehem, umetim keshehem ketannim.

Veikka deamri bachur hava. vehachi kaamar leh: "al ken al bachurav lo yismach Adonai veet yetomav veet almenotav lo yerachem ki chullo chanef umera vechol pe dover nevala bechol zot lo shav appo veod yado netuya". may "veod yado netuya"? amar rav chanan bar rav: hakkol yodin kalla lamma nichnesa lachuppa. ella, kol hamenabbel piv, umotzi devar nevala mippiv, afillu nechtam lo gezar dino shel shivim shana letova — nehpach alav leraa.
Ata lenachome — tzaore kamtzaar leh! hachi kaamar leh: chashiv at leittefose addara.

Amar leh: kum ema milleta keneged shevacho shel hakkadosh baruch hu. patach veamar: "hael haggadol berov godlo, addir vechazak berov noraot, mechayye metim bemaamaro, ose gedolot ad en cheker veniflaot ad en mispar. baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim".

Amar leh: kum ema milleta keneged avelim, patach veamar: "achenu hameyuggaim, hamedukkain baevel hazze, tenu levavchem lachkor et zot. zot hi omedet laad, nativ hu mishsheshet yeme vereshit. rabbim shatu, rabbim yishtu. kemishte rishonim kach mishte acharonim. achenu, baal nechamot yenachem etchem. baruch menachem avelim".

Amar abbaye: "rabbim shatu" — lema. "rabbim yishtu" — la lema. "mishte rishonim" — lema. "mishte acharonim" — la lema. deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, vechen tana mishshemeh derabbi yose: leolam al yiftach adam piv lassatan. amar rav yosef, may kera: "kisdom hayinu laamora daminu". may ahdar leh — "shimu devar Adonai ketzine sedom vegomer".

Amar leh: kum ema milleta keneged menachame avelim. patach veamar: "achenu gomle chasadim bene gomle chasadim, hammachzikim bivrito shel avraham avinu (shenneemar: 'ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve et banav vegomer'). achenu, baal haggemul yeshallem lachem gemulechem. baruch atta, meshallem haggemul".

Amar leh: kum ema milleta keneged kol yisrael. patach veamar: "ribbon haolamim, pede vehatztzel, mallet, hosha ammecha yisrael min haddever umin hacherev umin habbizza umin hashshiddafon umin hayyerakon umikkol mine pureaniyyot hammitraggeshot uvaot laolam, terem nikra veatta taane. baruch atta, otzer hammaggefa".

Amar ulla, veamri la bematnita tana: asara kosot tikkenu chachamim bevet haevel: shelosha kodem achila, kede liftoach et bene meav. shelosha betoch achila, kede lishrot achila shebbemeav. vearbaa leachar achila, echad keneged "hazzan", veechad keneged birkat haaretz, veechad keneged "bone yerushalayim", veechad keneged "hattov vehammetiv".

Hosifu alehem arbaa: echad keneged chazzane hair, veechad keneged parnase hair, veechad keneged bet hammikdash, veechad keneged rabban gamliel. hitchilu (hayu) shotin umishtakkerin, hechziru haddavar leyoshnah.

May rabban gamliel? detanya: barishona hayta hotzaat hammet kasha likrovav yoter mimmitato, ad shehayu mannichim oto uvorchin. ad shebba rabban gamliel venahag kallut beatzmo, vehotziuhu bichle fishtan. venahagu kol haam acharav lehotzi bichle fishtan. amar rav pappa: vehaiddana nehug alma afillu betzarda bar zuza.
Amar rabbi elazar:

a: Haomer "petach patuach matzati" — neeman leosrah alav.
Veammay? sefek sefeka hu: safek tachtav, safek en tachtav. veim timtza lomar tachtav: safek beones, safek beratzon!
La tzericha, beeshet kohen. veibbaet ema: beeshet yisrael, uchegon dekabbel ba avu kiddushin pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: haomer leishsha "kiddashtich", vehi omeret "lo kiddashtani" — hi mutteret bikrovav, vehu asur bikrovoteha.
Mahu detema: hatam devadday kim leh, aval hacha mekam hu dela kim leh, ka mashma lan.
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? vehaamar rabbi elazar: en haishsha neeseret al balah ella al iske kinnuy usetira, uchemaase shehaya!
Vetisbera maase shehaya, bekinnuy usetira hava? veod, mi asruha?

Ha la kashya, hachi kaamar: en haishsha neeseret al balah ella al iske kinnuy usetira, mimmaase shehaya, dela hava kinnuy usetira vela ittasra. mikkol makom kashya: kinnuy usetira — in, "petach patuach" — la!
Uletamaych: kinnuy usetira — in, edim — la?!
Ella hachi kaamar: en haishsha neeseret al balah beed echad, ella bishne edim. vekinnuy usetira — afillu beed echad name. ufetach patuach — kishne edim dame.
Vechi tema maase shehaya, mippene ma lo asaruha? hatam ones hava. veibbaet ema: ki ha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan:
b: Kol hayyotze lemilchemet bet david, get keritut kotev leishto. dichtiv: "veet achecha tifkod leshalom veet arubbatam tikkach", may "veet arubbatam tikkach"? tane rav yosef: devarim hameoravin beno levenah.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: betula nisset layyom harvii. leyom revii — in, leyom chamishi — la. may tama — mishshum ikkarore data.
Ulemay? i lemittav lah ketubba, nittev la! ella leosrah alav, udeka taen taana.
May lav, dekataen taanat "petach patuach"! la, dekataen taanat damim.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: haomer "petach patuach matzati", neeman lehafesidah ketubbatah. amar rav yosef: may ka mashma lan? tenena: haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello beedim — eno yachol liton taanat betulim, mippene shemmityayched immah. bihuda hu dela matze taen, ha baggalil matze taen.
Ulemay, i leosrah alav, bihuda ammay la? ella lav, lehafesidah ketubbatah, udeka taen taana. may lav, deka taen taanat "petach patuach"! la, deka taen taanat damim.

a: Ittemar, amar rav nachman amar shemuel mishshum rabbi shimon ben elazar: chachamim tikkenu lahem livnot yisrael, livtula matayim, ulealmana mane. vehem heeminuhu, sheim amar "petach patuach matzati" — neeman. im ken — ma hoilu chachamim betakkanatam?
Amar rava: chazaka, en adam toreach basseuda umafsidah.

Tana: hoil ukenas chachamim hu — lo tigbe ella min hazzibburit. kenasa? may kenasa?! ella ema: hoil vetakkanat chachamim hu — lo tigbe ella min hazzibburit. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ketubbat ishsha min hattora.

Umi amar rabban shimon ben gamliel hachi? vehatanya: "kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot": sheyyehe ze, kemohar habbetulot, umohar habbetulot kaze. mikkan samchu chachamim lichtubbat ishsha min hattora. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ketubbat ishsha enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim!
Efoch. umay chazet deafchat batrayyta, efoch kammayyta?
Ha shaminan leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel deamar ketubbat ishsha middeorayyta. ditnan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer — noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya.

Vei baet ema: kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: mikkan samchu chachamim lichtubbat ishsha min hattora. ketubbat almana enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim, sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ketubbat almana enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim.
Hahu daata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: petach patuach matzati. amar leh rav nachman: assevuhu kufere, mevarachta chavita leh?
Veha rav nachman hu deamar meheman! meheman, umassevinan leh kufere. rav achay meshanne: kan bevachur, kan benasuy.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel, amar leh: petach patuach matzati. amar leh: shemma hittetah? emshol lecha mashal: lema haddavar dome? leadam shehaya mehallech beishon layla vaafela, hitta — metzao patuach, lo hitta — metzao naul.

Ikka deamri, hachi amar leh: shemma bemezid hittetah, vaakart ledashsha veavra? emshol lecha mashal: lema haddavar dome? leadam shehu mehallech beishon layla vaafela, hitta bemezid — metzao patuach, lo hitta bemezid — metzao naul.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel bar rabbi, amar leh: rabbi, baalti velo matzati dam. amra lo: rabbi, betula hayiti. amar lahem: haviu li oto sudar. heviu lo hassudar, usherao bemayim vechibbeso, umatza alav kamma tippe damim. amar lo: lech zeche bemikkachecha.
Amar leh huna mar bereh derava mipparzikya lerav ashe: anan name naaved hachi. amar leh:
b: Gihutz shellanu, kechibbus shellahem. vei amrat nebad gihutz — meabbera leh chumarta.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel bar rabbi, amar leh: rabbi, baalti velo matzati dam. amara leh: rabbi, adayin betula ani. amar lahen: haviu li shete shefachot, achat betula veachat beula. heviu lo, vehoshivan al pi chavit shel yayin, beula — rechah nodef, betula — en rechah nodef. af zo hoshiva velo haya rechah nodef. amar lo: lech zeche bemikkachecha.
Venivdok meikkara begavvav? gemara hava shemia leh, maase la hava chaze, vesavar dilma la kim leh begavvav demilleta shappir, velav orach ara lezalzole bivnot yisrael.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabban gamliel hazzaken, amar lo: rabbi, baalti velo matzati dam, amra lo: rabbi, mimmishpachat dorketi ani, sheen lahen lo dam nidda velo dam betulim. badak rabban gamliel bikrovoteha, umatza kidvareha. amar lo: lech zeche bemikkachecha, ashrecha shezzachita lemishpachat dorketi.

May "dorketi" — dor katua. amar rabbi chanina: tanchumim shel hevel nichamo rabban gamliel leoto haish. detane rabbi chiyyay: keshem shehasseor yafe leissa, kach damim yafim laishsha. vetana mishshum rabbi meir: kol ishsha sheddameha merubbin — baneha merubbim.

Ittemar. rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: "zeche bemikkachecha" amar leh, verabbi yose bar avin amar: "nitchayyayv[ta] bemikkachecha" amar leh. bishlama leman deamar "nitchayyayv[ta]" — hayeynu derabbi chanina. ella leman deamar "zeche", may zechuta? dela ate lide sefek nidda.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi, amar leh: rabbi baalti velo matzati dam, amra lo: rabbi adayin betula ani. ushene vatztzoret hava, raa rabbi sheppenehem shechorim. tzivva alehen vehichnisum lammerchatz, veheechilum vehishkum, vehichnisum lacheder. baal, umatza dam. amar lo: lech zeche bemikkachecha. kare rabbi alehem: "tzafad oram al atzmam yavesh haya chaetz".
Mishna betula — ketubbatah matayim, vealmana — mane. betula, almana, gerusha vachalutza min haerusin — ketubbatan matayim, veyesh lahen taanat betulim.
Gemara may "almana"? amar rav chana bagdataa: "almana" — al shem mane. almana min haerusin, may ikka lememar! ayyeyde deha kare la almana, ha name kare la almana.

Almana dichtiva beorayyta, may ikka lememar? daatidin rabbanan dimtakkeni la mane. umi katev kera leatid? in, dichtiv: "veshem hannahar hashshelishi chiddekel hu haholech kidmat ashshur", vetana rav yosef: ashshur zo seleka. umi havay? ella daatida. hacha name daatida.

Veamar rav chana bagdataa: "matar" — mashke, marve, umezabbel, umeadden, umamshich. amar rava bar rabbi yishmael, veittema rav yemar bar shelemya, may kera: "telameha ravve nachet gedudeha birvivim temoggenna tzimchah tevarech".
Amar rabbi elazar: "mizbeach" — meziach, umezin, mechabbev, mechapper. hayeynu mechapper, hayeynu meziach! meziach gezerot, umechapper avonot.

Veamar rav chana bagdataa: tamre meshachanan, masbean, meshalshelan, meashsheran vela mefannekan. amar rav: achal temarim al yore. metivi: temarim, shacharit vearvit — yafot, bemincha — raot. batztzohorayim — en kemotan, umevattelot shelosha devarim: machshava raa, vecholi meayim, vetachtoniyyot!

Mi amrinan dela meallu? alloye meallu, ulefi shata tarda. midde dehave achamra. deamar mar hashshote reviit yayin — al yore. veibbaet ema: la kashya, ha — mikkamme nahama. ha — levatar nahama. deamar abbaye, amara li em: tamre mikkamme nahama — ki narga ledikkula. batar nahama — ki avra ledashsha.
"Dashsha", amar rava: derech sham. "darga" — amar rava: derech gag. "pureya" — amar rav pappa: shepparin veravin aleha. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:

a: Af anu nomar: "ayylonit" — ducheranit, dela yalda.
Mishna haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad — ketubbatan matayim. veyesh lahen taanat betulin.
Gemara amar rav huna: ger katan — matbilin oto al daat bet din.
May ka mashma lan — dizchut hu lo, vezachin laadam shello befanav? tenena: zachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin laadam shello befanav!
Mahu detema: goy behefkera nicha leh, deha kayyma lan deeved vadday behefkera nicha leh,
Ka mashma lan: dehane mille gadol, ditam taam deissura, aval katan — zechut hu lo.
Lema mesayyay leh: haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad. may lav, deatbelinhu al daat bet din?
La, hacha bemay askinan: beger shennitgayyeyru banav uvenotav immo, denicha lehu bemay deaved avuhon.

Amar rav yosef: higdilu — yecholin lemachot. etiveh abbaye: haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad — ketubbatan matayim. vei salka datach higdilu yecholin lemachot — yahavinan la ketuva deazla veachla begayyuta?
Lechi gadla. lechi gadla name memachayay venafka! kevan shehigdila shaa achat velo michata — shuv enah yechola lemachot.

Metiv rava, ellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas: habba al hammamzeret veal hannetina veal hakkutit veal haggiyyoret veal hashshevuya veal hashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad, yesh lahen kenas. vei amrat higdilu yecholin lemachot — yahavinan la kenas deazla veachla begeuta?
Lechi gadla. lechi gadla name memachayay venafka! kevan shehigdila shaa achat velo michata — shuv enah yechola lemachot.
Abbaye la amar kerava: hatam kenasa hayeynu tama — shello yehe chote niskar.
Rava la amar keabbayye: ketubba hayeynu tama — shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah.
Mishna haggadol shebba al hakketanna vekatan shebba al haggedola umukkat etz — ketubbatan matayim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mukkat etz ketubbatah mane.
Betula, almana, gerusha vachalutza min hannissuin — ketubbatan mane.
b: Veen lahen taanat betulim.
Haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru, yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad — ketubbatan mane, veen lahen taanat betulin.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: katan habba al haggedola — asaah mukkat etz. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: en mukkat etz bevasar.
Ikka dematne la leha shemata beappe nafsha: katan habba al haggedola, rav amar: asaah mukkat etz, ushemuel amar: en mukkat etz bevasar.
Metiv rav oshaya: gadol shebba al hakketanna, vekatan habba al haggedola, umukkat etz — ketubbatan matayim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mukkat etz ketubbatah mane.

Amar rava, hachi kaamar: gadol habba al hakketanna — velo kelum, defachot mikkan kenoten etzba baayin dame. vekatan habba al haggedola — asaah mukkat etz. umukkat etz gufa pelugeta derabbi meir verabbanan.
Amar rame bar chama: machaloket keshehikkir bah, derabbi meir medamme la levogeret. verabbanan medammu la livula, aval lo hikkir bah — divre hakkol velo kelum.

Verabbi meir, ammay medamme la levogeret? nedammeyay livula! beula — itavid ba maase bide adam, ha — la itavid ba maase bide adam. verabbanan, addimdammu la livula, nedammeyuha levogeret? bogeret — la itavid ba maase kelal, ha — itavid ba maase.
Aval lo hikkir bah — ledivre hakkol velo kelum. metiv rav nachman, hi omeret: mukkat etz ani, vehu omer: lo ki, ella derusat ish at — rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet.
Ella amar rava: ben hikkir bah uven lo hikkir bah — lerabbi meir matayim. lerabbanan, hikkir bah — mane, lo hikkir bah — velo kelum.

Vahadar beh rava, detanya: ketzad hotzaat shem ra? ba levet din veamar: peloni, lo matzati levittecha betulim. im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — yesh lah ketubba mane. im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — bat sekila hi! hachi kaamar: im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — biskila. zinneta meikkara — yesh lah ketubba mane.

Veamar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav sheshet: zot omeret, kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula — yesh lah ketubba mane. umetiv rav nachman: hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim, hi omeret: mishsheerastani neenasti venistachafa sadehu. vehu omer: lo chi, ella ad shello erastich, vehaya mikkachi mikkach taut. velet la kelal?

Vaamar lehu rav chiyyay bar avin: efshar rav amram vechol gedole haddor yatvi ki amar rav sheshet leha shemata vekashya lehu, veshanni: may "mikkach taut" name, mimmatayim. aval mane it la, veatt amrat let la kelal!

Veamar rava: man deka motev — shappir ka motev: mikkach taut ligmare mashma. veella kashya hach? taretz veema hachi: im yesh edim shezzinneta tachtav — biskila. zinneta meikkara — velo kelum. nimtzet mukkat etz yesh lah ketubba mane.
Veha rava hu deamar lerabbanan lo hikkir bah — velo kelum! ella shema minna hadar beh rava mehahi.
Tanu rabbanan: kenasah rishon leshum nissuin, veyesh lah edim shello nistera, i name nistera, velo shahata kede via — en hashsheni yachol liton taanat betulim. shehare kenasah rishon.

a: Amar rabba: zot omeret, kenasah bechezkat betula, venimtzet beula — yesh lah ketubba mane. rav ashe amar: bealma leolam ema lach let la kelal, veshane hacha, shehare kenasah rishon.
Venechush shemma tachtav zinneta! amar rav sherevya: kegon shekkiddesh uvaal lealtar.

Veikka dematne la ammatnitin: betula, almana, gerusha chalutza min hannissuin — ketubbatan mane, veen lahen taanat betulin. betula min hannissuin hechi mashkachat la? kegon shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala.
Amar rabba: zot omeret, kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula — ketubbatah mane. rav ashe amar: leolam ema lach bealma let la kelal, veshane hacha shehare nichnesa lechuppa.
Venechush shemma tachtav zinneta! amar rav sherevya: kegon shekkiddesh uvaal lealtar.
Man dematne la abbarayyta — kol shekken ammatnitin, uman dematne la ammatnitin — aval abbarayyta la, mishshum dematze amar la: ana aedim semachi.
Mishna haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello beedim — eno yachol liton taanat betulim, mippene shemmityayched immah.

Gemara middekatane "haochel", mikkelal deikka ducheta bihuda name dela achel. amar abbaye: shema minna bihuda name mekomot mekomot yesh. kidtanya, amar rabbi yehuda: bihuda, barishona hayu meyaychadin et hechatan veet hakkalla shaa achat kodem kenisatan lachuppa, kede sheyyehe libbo gas bah, uvaggalil lo hayu osin ken.
Bihuda, barishona hayu maamidin lahem shene shoshvinin, echad lo veechad lah, kede lemashmesh et hechatan veet hakkalla bishat kenisatan lachuppa, uvaggalil lo hayu osin ken.
Bihuda, barishona hayu shoshvinin yeshenim babbayit shechatan vechalla yeshenim bah, uvaggalil lo hayu osin ken.
Vechol shello nahag kamminhag hazze — eno yachol liton taanat betulim. aheyay? illema aresha, "kol shennahag" mibbee leh!
Ella assefa, "kol shello mushemash" mibbee leh!

Amar abbaye: leolam aresha, uteni: "kol shennahag". amar leh rava: veha "kol shello nahag" katane. ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: kol shello nahag minhag galil baggalil, ella minhag yehuda baggalil — eno yachol liton taanat betulim. rav ashe amar: leolam assefa, uteni: "kol shello mushemash".
Mishna achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohanim — ketubbatah mane. bet din shel kohanim hayu govin livtula arba meot zuz, velo michu beyadam chachamim.
Gemara tana: vealmenat kohanim — ketubbatah matayim. vehaanan tenan: achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohanim ketubbatan mane!
Amar rav ashe: shete takkanot havo, meikkara takkinu livtula arba meot zuz, ulealmana mane.
b: Kevan dachazo dimzalzeli behu, takkinu lehu matan. kevan dachazo deka parshin minnayyhu, deamri: ad denasvinan almenat kohanim — nezil nissev betula bat yisrael, ahderinhu lemilletayyhu.
Bet din shel kohanim kulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo bet din shel kohanim bilvad amru, ella afillu mishpachot hameyuchasot beyisrael, im ratzu laasot kederech shehakkohanim osin — osin.

Metivi: harotze laasot kederech shehakkohanim osin, kegon bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael — osin. bat yisrael lechohen uvat kohen leyisrael hu deikka tzad kehunna. aval bat yisrael leyisrael — la!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya bat yisrael leyisrael, dela matze amar la alloye ka meallena lich, aval bat yisrael lechohen, dematze amar la alloye ka meallena lich — ema la, ka mashma lan.

Mishna hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim. hi omeret: mishsheerastani neenasti, venistachafa sadehu. vehu omer: lo ki, ella ad shello erasticha, vehaya mikkachi mikkach taut — rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo bechezkat beula ad shello titares, vehitattu, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha.

Gemara ittemar: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: eni yodea — rav yehuda verav huna amri: chayyayv, verav nachman verabbi yochanan amri: patur. rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyayv — bari veshemma bari adif. rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur — oki mamona bechezkat mareh.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derav huna verav yehuda — dishmuel hi. ditnan: hayta meubberet, veamru lah: ma tivo shel ubbar ze? meish peloni, vechohen hu — rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel.

Vaamar leh rav shemuel bar yehuda lerav yehuda: shinnana, amart lan mishshemeh dishmuel: halacha kerabban gamliel af barishona. may af barishona? af al gav deikka lememar oke mamona bechezkat mareh — amar rabban gamliel: bari adif.
Lema rav yehuda verav huna deamri kerabban gamliel, verav nachman verabbi yochanan deamri kerabbi yehoshua?
Amar lecha rav nachman: ana daamari, afillu kerabban gamliel — ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam, ella deikka miggo. aval hacha, may miggo ikka?
I name: ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam ella deamrinan okma achazaka, aval hacha, may chazaka it leh lehay?
Hachi name mistabbera kidka meshannenan, derav nachman hu deamar kerabban gamliel,

a: Deim ken, kashya hilcheta ahilcheta. dekayyma lan hilcheta kerav nachman bedine, uveha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel. ella lav shema minna kidmishshenenan. shema minna.

Mishna hi omeret: mukkat etz ani. vehu omer: lo chi, ella derusat ish at. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet. verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo bechezkat derusat ish, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha.
Gemara taanatayyhu bemay? rabbi yochanan amar: bematayim umane. rabbi elazar amar: bemane velo kelum.

Rabbi yochanan amar: bematayim umane, savar la kerabbi meir, deamar: ben hikkir bah, uven lo hikkir bah — matayim. verabbi elazar omer: bemane velo kelum — savar la kerabbanan, deamri: ben hikkir bah, ben lo hikkir bah — mane.
Bishlama rabbi elazar lo kaamar kerabbi yochanan — deka moke la kerabbanan. ella rabbi yochanan may tama la amar kerabbi elazar?
Kasavar: kenasah bechezkat betula venimtzet beula — yesh lah ketubba mane. hacha, hu kaamar mane, vehi kaamra mane, may ikka ben taana dideh letaana dida?
Bishlama lerabbi elazar — hayeynu dekatane tarte: chada leappoke midderame bar chama,
Vachada leappoke midderav chiyyay bar avin amar rav sheshet. ella lerabbi yochanan tarte lema li?

Chada lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel, vachada lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua. kammayyta — lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehoshua, deaf al gav deikka lememar miggo — la mehemna. batrayyta — lehodiacha kocho derabban gamliel, deaf al gav delekka lememar miggo, mehemna.

Mishna rauha medabberet im echad, veamru lah: ma tivo shel ish ze? ish peloni, vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo bechezkat beula lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha.

Hayta meubberet, veamru lah: ma tivo shel ubbar ze? meish peloni, vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo bechezkat meubberet lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha.

Gemara may medabberet? zeeri amar: nistera, rav assi amar: nivala. bishlama lizeri, hayeynu dekatane medabberet. ella lerav assi, may medabberet? lishshana mealleya, kedichtiv: "achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven".
Bishlama lizeri — hayeynu dekatane tarte: "medabberet", umeubberet". ella lerav assi — tarte lema li?
Chada, lehacheshir bah. vachada, lehacheshir bevittah.

Hanicha leman deamar: ledivre hammachshir bah — machshir bevittah. ella leman deamar: ledivre hammachshir bah — posel bevittah, may ikka lememar? rav assi savar keman deamar ledivre hammachshir bah — machshir bevittah.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lizeri deamar may "medabberet" — nistera, veamar rabbi yehoshua la mehemna, haamar rav: malkin al hayyichud — veen osrin al hayyichud!
Lema dela kerabbi yehoshua? afillu tema rabbi yehoshua — maala asu beyuchasin.
Metivi: rauha shennichnesa im echad leseter,
b: O lechureba — veamru lah: ma tivo shel ish ze? kohen hu, uven achi abba hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo bechezkat beula lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha.
Bishlama lizeri — hayeynu dekatane tarte: leseter o lechureba. ella lerav assi deamar nivala, tarte lema li? chada katane: leseter dechureba.

Veha leseter o lechureba katane! chada lechureba demata, vachada lechureba dedavra. utzerichi, dei ashmeinan chureba demata — beha kamachshar rabban gamliel, mishshum derov kesherim etzlah. aval lechureba dedavra, derov pesulin etzlah — ema mode leh lerabbi yehoshua.
Vei ashmeinan behahi — behahi kaamar rabbi yehoshua, aval beha — ema mode lerabban gamliel, tzericha.

Metivi: zo edut shehaishsha keshera lah, verabbi yehoshua omer: enah neemenet. amar lahem rabbi yehoshua: i attem modim bishvuya shennishbet veyesh lah edim shennishbet, vehi omeret tehora ani, sheenah neemenet?
Amru lo: aval. uma hefresh yesh ben zo lazo? lazo — yesh edim, vlazo — en lah edim.
Amar lahem: af lazo yesh edim, shehare keresah ben shinneha. amru lo: rov goyim perutzim baarayot hem. amar lahen: en appotroppos laarayot.
Bamme devarim amurim — beedut ishsha begufah, aval edut ishsha bevittah — divre hakkol havvalad shetuki.

May kaamar lehu umay kamahderi leh? hachi kaamri leh: hashavtanu al hameubberet. ma teshivenu al hamedabberet? amar lahem: medabberet hayeynu shevuya. amru lo: shane shevuya, derov goyim perutzim baarayot hem. amar lahem: ha name, kevan deistattar, en appotroppos laarayot.
Katane mihat tarte — medabberet umeubberet. teyuveta derav assi teyuveta.

Vetippok leh dehatam rov pesulin etzlah, vehacha rov kesherin etzlah. mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ledivre hammachshir — machshir afillu berov pesulin, ledivre happosel — posel afillu berov kesherim.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre hammachshir bah — machshir bevittah. ledivre happosel bah — posel bevittah. verabbi elazar omer: ledivre hammachshir bah — posel bevittah.
Amar rabba, may tama derabbi elazar: bishlama ihi it la chazaka dechashrut. bittah, let la chazaka dechashrut.
Etiveh rabbi elazar lerabbi yochanan: bamme devarim amurim — beedut ishsha begufah, aval edut ishsha bevittah —divre hakkol havvalad shetuki. may lav shetuki, ufasul. la: shetuki, vechasher.
Umi ikka shetuki kasher? in, kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: asara kohanim omdim, uferash echad mehem uvaal — havvalad shetuki.

May "shetuki"? ilema shemmashtikin oto minnichse aviv — peshita, umi yadinan avu mannu? ella shemmashtikin oto middin kehunna, dichtiv: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam", mi shezzaro meyuchas acharav, yatza ze sheen zaro meyuchas acharav.
Hahu arus vaarusato daato lekammeh derav yosef, hi amra: minneh, vehu amar:

a: In, minnay. amar rav yosef: lemay nechush la? chada, deha ka mode. veod, ha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban gamliel.

Amar leh abbaye: uveha, ki la mode machshar rabban gamliel? vehaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, halacha kerabban gamliel, veat la taaved ovada ad deikka rov kesherin etzlah. vehacha — rov pesulin etzlah!
Velitamaych tikshe lach hi gufa: halacha, veat la taaved ovada?! ella may it lach lememar: ha — lechattechilla, ha — diavad. veha name, kediavad dame.
Rame leh abbaye lerava: umi amar rabbi yehoshua enah neemenet? ureminhu: heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ben betera al almenat issa, shehi keshera lakkehunna.
Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam: ishsha nisset, bodeket venisset. hacha, ishsha mezanna bodeket umezanna?!

Amar rava: derabbi yehoshua adderabbi yehoshua kashya, derabban gamliel adderabban gamliel la kashya? veha katane sefa: amar lahen rabban gamliel: kibbalnu edutechem, aval ma naase shehare gazar rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello lehoshiv bet din al kach, shehakkohanim shomin lachem lerachek aval lo lekarev.
Ella amar rava: derabban gamliel adderabban gamliel la kashya: hatam — bari, hacha — shemma.
Derabbi yehoshua adderabbi yehoshua name la kashya: hatam — chad sefeka, hacha — tere sefeke.

Hilkach, lerabban gamliel: allim leh bari, daafillu bechad sefeka name machshir. vekil leh shemma, daafillu bisfek sefeka name pasel. lerabbi yehoshua: allim leh chad sefeka, daafillu bevari name pasel, vekil leh sefek sefeka, daafillu bishma name machshir.
Tanu rabbanan: ezohi almenat issa? kol sheen bah lo mishshum mamzerut, velo mishshum netinut, velo mishshum avde melachim. amar rabbi meir:
b: Shamati, kol sheen bah echad mikkol ellu — massiin lakkehunna.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav: ezohi almenat issa — kol shennitma bah sefek chalal.
Makkirin yisrael mamzerim shebbenehem, veen makkirin chalalin shebbenehem.
Amar mar: ezohi almenat issa — kol sheen bah lo mishshum mamzerut, velo mishshum netinut, velo mishshum avde melachim. ha chalal — kasher.
May shena hanach — deorayyta, chalal name deorayyta! vetu, amar rabbi meir: shamati, kol sheen bah echad mikkol ellu massiin lakkehunna, hayeynu tanna kamma?!

Vetu: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav: ezohi almenat issa — kol shennitma bah sefek chalal, makkirin yisrael mamzerim shebbenehen veen makkirin chalalin shebbenehen. veha amrat resha, chalal kasher!

Amar rabbi yochanan: mamzer tzoveach vechalal shotek ikka benayyhu: tanna kamma savar: kol pesul dekaru leh veshatek — pasul. vehachi kaamar tanna kamma: ezohi almenat issa — kol sheen bah lo shetuk mamzerut, velo shetuk netinut, velo shetuk avde melachim, velo shetuk chalal.
Vekaamar leh rabbi meir: hanach hu deka pasel leh bekahal, aval shetuk chalal — kasher. veha deshatek — mishshum dela ichpat leh.

Vekaamar leh rabbi shimon ben elazar letanna kamma derabbi meir: i shemia lach demachshar rabbi meir bishtika — la dekaru leh "chalal" veshatek, ella dekaru leh "mamzer" veshatek. vehay deshatek, savar mamzer kala it leh. aval mamzer vetzoveach, chalal veshotek — pasul. vehay deishtik, savar missatyeh dela mappeki leh mikkahal.
Tane chada, rabbi yose omer: shetuk mamzer — kasher, shetuk chalal — pasul. vetanya iddach: shetuk chalal — kasher, shetuk mamzer — pasul.
La kashya: ha tanna kamma allibba derabbi meir, ha derabbi shimon ben elazar allibba derabbi meir.
Mishna amar rabbi yose: maase betinoket sheyyarda lemalloot mayim min haayin, veneenasa. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: im rov anshe hair massiin lichhunna, hare zo tinnase lichhunna.

Gemara amar leh rava lerav nachman: rabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar keman? i kerabban gamliel — afillu berov pesulin name machshar. i kerabbi yehoshua — afillu berov kesherim name pasel! amar leh, hachi amar rav yehuda amar rav:

a: Bikronot shel tzippori haya maase, vechidrabbi amme. deamar rabbi amme: vehu shehayta sia shel bene adam kesherin overet lesham, vechidrabbi yannay. deamar rabbi yannay: nivelet bikronot keshera lakkehunna.
Bikronot salka datach? ella nivelet bishat keronot, keshera lakkehunna. aval perash echad mitztzippori uvaal — havvalad shetuki.
Ki ha dechi ata rav dimi, amar zeeri, amar rabbi chanina, veamri la, amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: holchin achar rov hair, veen holchin achar rov sia.
Kelappe leyay?! hane nayydi, vehane kevii vekayymi!
Ella: holchin achar rov hair, vehu deikka rov sia bahada, veen holchin achar rov hair geredta, velo achar rov sia geredta. may tama? gezera rov sia attu rov hair.
Verov hair name, i deka azli inhu legabba: kol defaresh — merubba paresh! la tzericha, deka azla ihi legabbayyhu, dehave leh kavua, veamar rabbi zera: kol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame.

Umi baenan tere rubbe? vehatanya: tesha chanuyot kullan mochrot besar shechuta, veachat mocheret besar nevela, velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea mee ze mehen lakach — sefeko asur. uvannimtza — hallech achar harov.
Vechi tema besheen daltot medina neulot, deka ate la rubba mealma — veha amar rabbi zera: af al pi sheddaltot medina neulot! maala asu beyuchasin.
Gufa, amar rabbi zera: kol kavua — kemechetza al mechetza dame, ben lekulla ben lechumera.

Mena leh lerabbi zera ha? illema mittesha chanuyot, kullan mochrot besar shechuta, veachat besar nevela, velakach meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach — sefeko asur, uvannimtza — hallech achar harov; hatam lechumera!
Ella mittisha tzefardeim vesheretz echad benehem, venaga beechad mehen, veeno yodea beeze mehen naga — sefeko tame. hatam name lechumera!
Ella mittisha sheratzim utzefardea echad benehem, venaga beechad mehen, veeno yodea beeze mehen naga. birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame. birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor.
Umiddeorayyta mena lan? amar kera: "vearav lo vekam alav", ad sheyyitkavven lo. verabbanan? amri deve rabbi yannay: perat lezorek even legav.
Hechi dame? illema deikka tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehem — tippok li derubba goyim ninhu. i name, palga ufalga — sefek nefashot lehakel.
La tzericha: deikka tisha yisreelim vegoy echad benehem, dehave leh goy kavua, vechol kavua — kemechetza al mechetza dame.
Ittemar, rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose. verav chanan bar rava amar rav: horaat shaa hayta.
Metiv rabbi yirmeya: uleyuchasin la baenan tere rubbe? vehatnan:
b: Matza bah tinok mushelach, im rov goyim — goy. im rov yisrael — yisrael. mechetza al mechetza — yisrael.
Veamar rav: lo shanu ella lehacheyoto, aval leyuchasin — lo. ushemuel amar: lefakkeach alav et haggal.
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: bikronot shel tzippori hava maase.
Ulerav chanan bar rava, deamar: horaat shaa hayta, kashya ha? man dematne ha, la matne ha.

Gufa: matza bah tinok mushelach, im rov goyim — goy, im rov yisrael — yisrael, mechetza al mechetza — yisrael. amar rav: lo shanu ella lehacheyoto, aval leyuchasin — lo. ushemuel amar: lefakkeach alav et haggal.

Umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en holchin befikkuach nefesh achar harov! ella ki ittemar dishmuel — aresha ittemar: im rov goyim — goy, amar shemuel: ulefakkeach alav et haggal eno ken.
Im rov goyim — goy, lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: lehaachilo nevelot.
Im rov yisrael — yisrael, lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: lehachezir lo aveda.
Mechetza al mechetza — yisrael, lemay hilcheta? amar resh lakish: linzakin. hechi dame? i nema denagcheh tora didan letora dideh — lema leh: ayyti reaya deyisrael at ushekol!
La tzericha: denagcheh tora dideh letora didan, palga meshallem. veiddach palga — amar lehu: ayyte reaya delav yisrael ana, veetten lechon.
Hadaran alach betula nisset

Haishsha shennitarmela o shennitgarsha. hi omeret: betula nesatani, vehu omer: lo ki, ella almana nesatich. im yesh edim sheyyatzat behinuma veroshah parua — ketubbatah matayim. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af chilluk kelayot reaya.
Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero: sade zo shel avicha hayta ulekachtiha hemennu, shehu neeman,

a: Shehappe sheasar — hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehi shel aviv, vehu omer: "lekachtiha hemennu" — eno neeman.
Gemara tama deikka edim, ha lekka edim — baal meheman, lema tenan setama dela kerabban gamliel? dei rabban gamliel, ha amar ihi mehemna!
Afillu tema rabban gamliel, ad kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam ella bevari veshemma. aval hacha bevari uvari — la amar.
Udekaare la, may kaare la? ha bari uvari hu! kevan derov nashim betulot nissaot, ki vari veshemma dame.
Vehachi name mistabbera middekatane, "umode rabbi yehoshua": i amrat bishlama ayyri rabban gamliel bemode — shappir. ella i amrat la ayyri rabban gamliel bemode — rabbi yehoshua leman mode?
Mi savrat rabbi yehoshua ahay pirkin kae? ammiggo kae, veappirkin kamma kae.

Aheyay? illema aha: hayta meubberet, veamru lah "ma tivo shel ubbar ze". "meish peloni vechohen hu", rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin — hatam may miggo ikka? hare keresah ben shinneha.

Ella aha: rauha medabberet im echad, veamru lah: "ma tivo shel ish ze". "ish peloni vechohen hu", rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin. hatam may miggo ikka? hanicha lizeri deamar: may "medabberet" — nistera, miggo dei baaya amra lo nivalti, vekaamra nivalti — mehemna. ella lerav assi, deamar may "medabberet" — nivelet, may miggo ikka?
Veella aha: hi omeret mukkat etz ani, vehu omer: lo chi, ella derusat ish at. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin — hatam may miggo ikka?

Bishlama lerabbi elazar, deamar: bemane velo kelum — miggo dei baaya amra: "mukkat etz ani tachtecha", veit la matayim, vekaamra: meikkara, delet la ella mane, mehemna. ella lerabbi yochanan deamar: bematayim umane. may miggo ikka?
Ella aha: hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim, hi omeret: "mishsheerastani neenasti, venistachafa sadehu", vehu omer: "lo chi, ella ad shello erastich".

Rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim: neemenet, verabbi yehoshua omer: lo mippiha anu chayyin. demiggo dei baaya amra "mukkat etz ani tachtecha", dela ka fasla nafshah mikkehunna. vekaamra: "neenasti", deka pasla nafshah mikkehunna, mishshum hachi kaamar rabban gamliel dimhemna. vekaamar rabbi yehoshua lerabban gamliel: behay miggo dehacha — modena lach, behahu miggo dehatam — peligna illavoch.
Mikkedi hay miggo vehay miggo, may shena hay miggo mehay miggo? hacha — en shor shachut lefanecha. hatam — hare shor shachut lefanecha.
Vechevan derov nashim betulot nissaot, ki la atu edim may have! amar ravina: mishshum deikka lememar rov nashim betulot nissaot, umiut almanot, vechol hannisset betula — yesh lah kol,
b: Vezo, hoil veen lah kol — ittera le rubba.
I kol hannisset betula yesh lah kol — ki ato edim, may have? hanach sahade shakkare ninhu! ella amar ravina: rov hannisset betula yesh lah kol, vezo hoil veen lah kol — ittera le rubba.

Im yesh edim sheyyatzta behinuma vechulei. velechush dilma mappeka edim behay be dina, vegavya, vahadar mappeka la lichtuva behay bet din, vegavya ba? amar rabbi avahu: zot omeret kotvin shovar. rav pappa amar: bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan.

Veikka dematne la abbarayyta: ibbeda ketubbatah, hitmina ketubbatah, nisrefa ketubbatah, rakdu lefaneha, sachaku lefaneha, heeviru lefaneha kos shel besora, o mappa shel betulim. im yesh lah edim beechad mikkol ellu — ketubbatah matayim.

Velechush dilma mappeka edim behay bet din vegavya, vahadar mappeka lichtubbatah behay bet din vegavya ba! amar rabbi avahu: zot omeret kotvin shovar. rav pappa amar: bimkom sheen kotvin ketubba askinan.
Veha "ibbeda ketubbatah" katane! dichtav la ihu. sof sof mappeka la vegavya ba! may "ibbeda" — ibbeda baur.
I hachi hayeynu "nisrefa"? veod: hitmina, may ikka lememar? vetu: ibbeda lema li? ella: kol ibbeda — ki hitmina befanenu dame, vela yahavinan la ad deamri edim nisrefa ketubbatah.
Man dematne la abbarayyta — kol shekken ammatnitin. uman dematne la ammatnitin — aval abbarayyta la, ki kusheya.
Im yesh edim kulei. velechush dilma mappeka ede hinnuma behay bet din vegavya, vahadar mappeka ede hinnuma beve dina acharina vegavya! bemakom dela efshar vadday katvinan shovar.

Heeviru lefaneha kos shel besora. may "kos shel besora"? amar rav adda bar ahava: kos yayin shel teruma maavirin lefaneha. kelomar: reuya hayta zo leechol bitruma. matkef la rav pappa: attu almana mi la achla bitruma? ella amar rav pappa: zo reshit, kitruma reshit.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chavit shel yayin maavirin lefaneha. amar rav adda bar ahava: betula — maavirin lefaneha setuma, beula — maavirin lefaneha petucha. ammay? niabbar kamme betula vekamme beula la niabbar kelal! zimnin detafsa matayim, veamra: ana betula havay, vehay dela abbaru kammay — ittenose hu deittenisu.
Tanu rabbanan: ketzad merakkedin lifne hakkalla? bet shammay omrim:

a: Kalla kemot shehi. uvet hillel omrim: "kalla naa vachasuda". amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: hare shehayta chiggeret o soma, omrim lah: "kalla naa vachasuda"? vehattora amra: "middevar sheker tirchak"! amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: ledivrechem, mi shellakach mikkach ra min hashshuk, yeshabbechennu beenav, o yegannennu beenav? heve omer: yeshabbechennu beenav. mikkan amru chachamim: leolam tehe dato shel adam meorevet im habberiyyot.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: hachi mesharu kamme kalleta bemareva: "lo kachal velo sarak velo pirkus veyaalat chen". ki samchu rabbanan lerabbi zera, sharu leh hachi: "la kachal velo sarak velo pirkus veyaalat chen".

Ki semachu rabbanan lerabbi amme ulerabbi assi sharu lehu hachi: "kol min den vechol min den semuchu lana, la tismuchu lana la min sarmisin vela min sarmitin", veamri la: "la min chamisin vela min turemisin".
Rabbi avahu ki hava ate mimmetivta leve kesar, nafkan amhata deve kesar leappeh umesharyan leh hachi: "rabba deammeh umedabberana deummeteh, butzina dinhora, berich metyaych lishlam".

Amru alav al rabbi yehuda bar ilay shehaya notel bad shel hadas, umerakked lifne hakkalla, veomer: "kalla naa vachasuda". rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak merakked attelat. amar rabbi zera: ka machsef lan sava: ki nach nafsheh, ippesik ammuda denura ben dideh lechulle alma, ugemiri dela ippesik ammuda denura ella i lechad bedara, i litre bedara.
Amar rabbi zera: ahanyay leh shotiteh lesava. veamri la: shetuteh lesava. veamri la: shitteh lesava.
Rav acha markev la akkatpeh umerakked. amri leh rabbanan: anan mahu lemibad hachi? amar lehu: i damyayn alayychu kichshura — lechayye, vei la — la.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: muttar lehistakkel bifne challa kol shiva, kede lechabbevah al balah. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Tanu rabbanan: maavirin et hammet millifne challa. veze vaze millifne melech yisrael. amru alav al agrippas hammelech sheavar millifne kalla, veshibbechuhu chachamim.

Shibbechuhu — mikkelal deshappir avad? veha amar rav ashe: afillu leman deamar nasi shemmachal al kevodo — kevodo machul, melech shemmachal al kevodo — en kevodo machul. deamar mar: "som tasim alecha melech", shettehe emato alecha! parashat derachim havay.

Tanu rabbanan: mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulehachnasat kalla. amru alav al rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay shehaya mevattel talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulehachnasat kalla. bamme devarim amurim — kesheen immo kol tzarko. aval yesh immo kol tzarko — en mevattelin.

Vechamma kol tzarko? amar rav shemuel bar ini mishshemeh derav: teresar alfe gavre, veshitta alfe shippure. veamri la: telesar alfe gavre, uminnayyhu shitta alfe shippure. ulla amar: kegon dechayytzi gavre meavulla vead sichra. rav sheshet, veittema rabbi yochanan amar: netilatah — kintinatah, ma netinatah beshishshim ribbo, af netilatah beshishshim ribbo. vehane mille leman dekare vetane,
b: Aval leman dematne, let leh shiura.
Veim yesh edim sheyyatzta behinuma vechulei. may hinnuma? surechav bar pappa mishshemeh dizeri amar: tannura deassa. rabbi yochanan amar: karita dimnamnema bah kalleta.

Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer vechulei. tana bihuda reaya, bevavel may? amar rav: dardoge demishcha aresha derabbanan. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: mishcha dachafifuta kaamar mar? amar leh: yatma, la avada lach immach dardoge mishcha aresha derabbanan bishat maase? ki ha dehahu merabbanan deiasak leh livreh be rabba bar ulla, veamri la, rabba bar ulla iasak leh livreh be hahu merabbanan, vedardeg mishcha aresha derabbanan bishat maase.
Armalta may? tane rav yosef: armalta let la kisane.
Umode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero kulei. velitne: mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero sade zo shellecha hayta, ulekachtiha mimmecha?
Mishshum deka vae lemitne sefa: im yesh edim shehi shello, vehu omer: "lekachtiha mimmennu" — eno neeman. hechi dame?
I deachla shene chazaka — ammay la meheman?! vei dela achla shene chazaka — peshita dela meheman!
I hachi, gabbe aviv name: i deachla shene chazaka — ammay la meheman?! vei dela achla shene chazaka — peshita dela meheman!
Bishlama gabbe aviv mashkachat la, kegon sheachalah shetayim bechayye haav, veachat bechayye veno, vechidrav huna. deamar rav huna: en machazikin benichse katan, afillu higdil.
Verav huna matnitin ata leashmoinan? ibbaet ema: rav huna diyyuka dematnitin kaamar. veibbaet ema: afillu higdil ka mashma lan.
Velitneyay bedideh, velokma kegon sheachalah shetayim befanav veachat shello befanav, uchegon shebbarach.
Barach mechamat may? i devarach mechamat nefashot — peshita dela meheman, dela matze [m]mache. vei devarach mechamat mamon, ibbei leh lemachoye. dekayyma lan: mechaa shello befanav — havya mechaa.
Ditnan, shalosh aratzot lachazaka: yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. haya bihuda vehechezik baggalil, baggalil vehechezik bihuda — enah chazaka, ad sheyyehe immo bimdina.
Vehavenan ba: may kasavar? i kasavar mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa — afillu bihuda vegalil name. vei kasavar mechaa shello befanav la havya mechaa — afillu yehuda vihuda name la!
Amar rabbi abba bar memel: leolam kasavar mechaa shello befanav havya mechaa, umatnitin bishat cherum shanu.
Umay shena yehuda vegalil denaket?

a: Distam yehuda ugelil kishat cherum damu.

Velitne: mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero "mane laviti mimmecha uferativ lach", shehu neeman! mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa: im yesh edim shehu lava mimmennu, vehu omer: perativ — eno neeman, veha kayyma lan hammalve et chavero beedim — eno tzarich leforo beedim.
Velitne: mode rabbi yehoshua beomer lachavero: mane leavich beyadi, veheechaltiv peras — shehu neeman!
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbanan — ha amri meshiv aveda have. i allibba derabbi eliezer ben yaakov — ha amar shevua bae.

Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo. ketzad? "mane leavich beyadi veheechaltiv peras" — hare ze nishba, vezehu shennishba al taanat atzmo. vachachamim omrim: eno ella kemeshiv aveda, ufatur.
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov let leh meshiv aveda patur? amar rav: betoano katan. vehaamar mar: en nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan!
May katan — gadol. veammay kare leh katan — dilgabbe mille deaviv, katan hu. i hachi: taanat atzmo? taanat acherim hi! taanat acherim, vehodaat atzmo.
Kullehi taanata, taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu!

Ella hacha bidrabba kamippalgi. deamar rabba: mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava — chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo. vehay bechulla bae delichpereh, vehay dela kefar leh — mishshum deen adam meiz panav hu.
b: Uvechulla bae delode leh. vehay dela odi leh — ki hechi delishtemit leh, vesavar: ad dehave li zuze ufarana leh. verachamana amar: remi shevua aleh, ki hechi delode leh bechulleh.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: la shena bo vela shena bivno, eno meiz, vehilkach lav meshiv aveda have. verabbanan savri: bo hu deeno meiz, aval bivno — meiz. umiddelo heiz — meshiv aveda have.

Mishna haedim sheamru: ketav yadenu hu ze, aval anusim hayinu, ketannim hayinu, pesule edut hayinu — hare ellu neemanim. veim yesh edim shehu ketav yadam, o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher — enan neemanin.
Gemara amar rame bar chama: lo shanu ella sheamru "anusim hayinu mechamat mamon". aval "anusim hayinu mechamat nefashot" — hare ellu neemanin.

Amar leh rava: kol keminneh?! kevan shehiggid — shuv eno chozer umaggid. vechi tema: hane mille al pe, aval bishtar — la, veha amar resh lakish: edim hachatumim al hashshetar — naasa kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din!

Ella, ki ittemar — aresha ittemar: hare ellu neemanin, amar rame bar chama: lo shanu ella sheamru: anusin hayinu mechamat nefashot, aval amru: anusin hayinu mechamat mamon — en neemanin. may tama: en adam mesim atzmo rasha.

Tanu rabbanan: en neemanim lefoslo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: neemanim. bishlama lerabbanan ki tamayyhu, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. ella lerabbi meir, may tama? bishlama pesule edut, malve gufeh meikkara middak dayek umachtem. ketannim name, kidrabbi shimon ben lakish. deamar resh lakish:

a: Chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken naasa begadol. ella anusin, may tama?
Amar rav chisda, kasavar rabbi meir: edim sheamru lahem "chitmu sheker veal tehargu" — yehargu veal yachtemu sheker.

Amar leh rava: hasheta illu atu lekamman leimmeloche, amrinan lehu: zilu chatumu vela titkattelun, deamar mar: en lecha davar sheomed bifne pikkuach nefesh ella avoda zara, vegilluy arayot, ushefichut damim bilvad. hasheta dachatamu, amrinan lehu: ammay chatmitu?
Ella: tama derabbi meir kidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: mode bishtar shekketavo — en tzarich lekayyeymo.
Gufa. amar rav huna amar rav: mode bishtar shekketavo — en tzarich lekayyeymo. amar leh rav nachman: gannova gannove lema lach. i sevira lach kerabbi meir, ema halacha kerabbi meir.
Amar leh: umar hechi sevira leh? amar leh: ki atu lekamman ledina, amrinan lehu: "zilu kayyimu shetarayychu vechutu ledina".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: haomer "shetar amana hu ze" — eno neeman.

Dekaamar man? ilema dekaamar love — peshita, kol keminneh?! veella dekaamar malve — tavo alav beracha. ella dekaamri edim. i dichtav yadam yotze mimmakom acher — peshita dela mehemni. vei deen ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher — ammay la mehemni?
(Siman baesh) amar rava: leolam dekaamar love, vechidrav huna. deamar rav huna amar rav: mode bishtar shekketavo — en tzarich lekayyeymo.
Abbaye amar: leolam deamar malve, uchegon shechav laacherim, vechidrabbi natan.
Detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, vachavero bachavero — minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze — talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".

Rav ashe amar: leolam dekaamri edim. udeen ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher. udekaamrat ammay la mehemni — kidrav kahana. deamar rav kahana: asur lo laadam sheyyeshahe shetar amana betoch beto, mishshum shenneemar: "al tashken beohalecha avla".
b: Veamar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: shema minna midderav kahana, edim sheamru "amana hayu devarenu" — en neemanin. may tama? kevan deavla hu — aavla la chatmi.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur lo laadam sheyyeshahe shetar parua betoch beto, mishshum shenneemar: "al tashken beohalecha avla". bemareva mishshemeh derav amri: "im aven beyadcha harechikehu" — ze shetar amana ushetar passim. "veal tashken beohalecha avla" — ze shetar parua.
Man deamar shetar parua, kol shekken shetar amana. uman deamar shetar amana — aval shetar parua la, dezimnin dimshahe leh appeshite desafra.
Ittemar: sefer sheeno muggah, amar rabbi amme: ad sheloshim yom muttar leshahoto, mikkan veelach asur leshahoto, mishshum shenneemar: "al tashken beohalecha avla".

Amar rav nachman: edim sheamru amana hayu devarenu — en neemanin. modaa hayu devarenu — en neemanin. mar bar rav ashe amar: amana hayu devarenu — en neemanin, modaa hayu devarenu — neemanin. may tama? hay — nittan likkatev. vehay — lo nittan likkatev.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: tenay hayu devarenu, mahu? modaa vaamana, hayeynu tama — deka akri leh lishtara, vehay name ka akar lishtara. o dilma: tenay milleta achariti hi? amar leh: ki atu lekamman ledina, amrinan lehu: zilu kayyimu tenaayychu vechutu ledina.
Ed omer "tenay", veed omer "eno tenay". amar rav pappa: tarvayyhu bishtara mealleya ka mashadi, vehay dekaamar: "tenay" — have leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: i hachi, afillu tarvayyhu name? ella amrinan: hane lemikar sahadutayyhu kaatu, hay name lemikar sahaduteh kaate: vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.

Tanu rabbanan: shenayim chatumin al hashshetar umetu, uvau shenayim min hashshuk veamru: yadanu shekketav yadam hu, aval anusim hayu, ketannim hayu, pesule edut hayu — hare ellu neemanim. veim yesh edim shekketav yadam hu ze, o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchezak bevet din — en ellu neemanin.
Umagbenan beh kevishtara mealleya? veammay? tere utere ninhu!
Amar rav sheshet, zot omeret: hachechasha — techillat hazama hi,

a: Ucheshem sheen mezimmin et haedim ella bifnehem, kach en machchishin et haedim ella bifnehem.

Amar leh rav nachman: illu havo kamman umachchishin lehu, hava hachechasha, vela hava mashgichin behu. dehavya[1] la edut muchecheshet. hasheta deletanhu, deillu havo lekamman dilma havo modu lehu, mehemni?!

Ella amar rav nachman: oke tere lahade tere, veoke mamona bechezkat mareh, midde dehave annichse devar shatya. devar shatya zabben nichse. ato be tere, amri: keshehu shote zabben, vaato be tere veamri: keshehu chalim zabben.

Amar rav ashe: oke tere lahade tere, veoki mamona bechezkat bar shatya. vela amaran ella deit leh chazaka daavahateh. aval let leh chazaka daavahateh, amrinan: keshehu shote zevan, ucheshehu shote zabben.
Amar rabbi avahu: en mezimmin et haedim ella bifnehen, umachchishin et haedim shello bifnehen. vahazama shello bifnehen, nehi dahazama la havya — hachechasha miha havya.

Amar mar: im yesh edim shekketav yadam hu ze, o shehaya ketav yadam yotze mimmakom acher, mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchezak bevet din — en neemanin. kara alav arar — in, lo kara alav arar — la, mesayyay leh lerabbi assi. deamar rabbi assi: en mekayyeymin et hashshetar ella mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchezak bevet din.
Amri nehardae: en mekayyeymin et hashshetar ella mishte ketubbot, [o] mishshete sadot, vehu sheachalum baalehen shalosh shanim, uveshofi.

Amar rav shimi bar ashe: uveyotze mittachat yad acher. aval miyyad atzmo — la. may shena tachat yad atzmo dela, dilma zayyofe mezayyef. mittachat yede acher name: dilma azal vachaza, ata vezayyef! kulle hay la matze mechavven.

Tanu rabbanan: kotev adam eduto al hashshetar, umeid aleha afillu leachar kamma shanim. amar rav huna: vehu shezzochrah meatzmo. rabbi yochanan amar: af al pi sheen zochrah meatzmo. amar rabba: shema minna midderabbi yochanan: hane be tere deyadi sahaduta uminneshe chad minnayyhu, madkar chad lechavreh.
Ibbaya lehu: atzmo, may? rav chaviva amar: afillu atzmo. mar bereh derav ashe amar: atzmo lo. vehilcheta atzmo lo.
b: Vei tzureba merabbanan hu, afillu atzmo. ki ha derav ashe hava yedia leh besahaduta lerav kahana. amar leh: mi dechir mar hay sahaduta? amar leh: la. velav hachi vehachi hava? amar leh: la yadana, lesof iddechar rav ashe, ashed leh. chazyeh lerav kahana dahava mechassem. amar leh: mi savrat alach ka semichna? ana hu dirmay annafshay veiddachri.

Tenan hatam: hatteluliyyot hakkerovot ben lair uven ladderech, echad chadashot veechad yeshanot — temeot. harchokot, chadashot — tehorot, yeshanot — temeot. ezohi kerova — chamishshim amma, veezo hi yeshana — shishshim shana, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kerova — sheen kerova hemenna, yeshana — sheen adam zochrah.

May "ir" umay "derech"? ilema "ir" — ir mammash, "derech" — derech mammash, missefeka mi machzekinan tumea? vehaamar resh lakish: illa matzu vetiharu eretz yisrael. amar rabbi zera: "ir" — ir hassemucha levet hakkevarot, vederech" — derech bet hakkevarot.
Bishlama derech bet hakkevarot, dezimnin demitreme ben hashshemashot umikkeru kavru betel. ella ir hassemucha levet hakkevarot, kullehi levet hakkevarot azli?

Amar rabbi chanina: mittoch shehannashim kovrot sham niflehen, umukke shechin zerootehem — ad chamishshim amma azla ihi lechudda. tefe — davra inish bahada, ulevet hakkevarot azla. hilkach, tumea beeretz yisrael la machzekinan.
Amar rav chisda: shema minna merabbi meir, hay sahaduta ad shittin shenin — middechar, tefe — la middechar. vela hi, hatam hu dela ramya aleh. aval hacha, kevan derame aleh, afillu tuva name.

Mishna ze omer: ketav yadi, veze ketav yado shel chaveri. veze omer: ze ketav yadi, veze ketav yado shel chaveri — hare ellu neemanin. ze omer: ze ketav yadi, veze omer: ze ketav yadi — tzerichin letzaref immahem acher, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: enam tzerichin letzaref immahen acher, ella neeman adam lomar ze ketav yadi.
Gemara keshettimtze lomar, ledivre rabbi

a: Al ketav yadan hem meidim. ledivre chachamim, al mane shebbashshetar hem meidim.
Peshita? mahu detema lerabbi sappoke mesappeka leh i al ketav yadam hem meidim, o al mane shebbashshetar hem meidim.
Venafka minna, hecha demit chad minnayyhu, live shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav.
Deim ken, kanafek neche riva demamona appumma dechad sahada.
Vehacha lechumera vehacha lechumera.

Ka mashma lan derabbi mifshat peshita leh, ben lekulla ben lechumera. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: shenayim hachatumin al hashshetar umet echad mehen — tzerichin shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav, bezo rabbi lekulla. verabbanan lechumera.

Vei lekka tere ella chad, may? amar abbaye: lichtov chatimat yedeh achaspa, veshade leh beve dina, umachzeki leh be dina (vechazu leh), vela tzarich ihu leashode achatimat yedeh, veazel ihu vehay, umashadi aiddach.
Vedavka achaspa, aval ammegilleta la, dilma mashkach la inish dela mealle vechatev illaveh may devae. utenan: hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyayv lo — gove minnechasim bene chorin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kedivre chachamim. peshita! yachid verabbim — halacha kerabbim! mahu detema halacha kerabbi mechavero, vaafillu mechaverav, ka mashma lan.
Siman: nach nad chad. amar leh rav chinnana bar chiyyay lerav yehuda, veamri la rav huna bar yehuda lerav yehuda, veamri la rav chiyyay bar yehuda lerav yehuda: umi amar shemuel hachi?

Veha hahu shetara dinfak mibbe dina demar shemuel, vahava ketiv beh: middaata rav anan bar chiyyay veashed achatimut yedeh veaddechad deimmeh, umannu — rav chanan bar rabba, umiddaata rav chanan bar rabba veashed achatimut yedeh veaddechad deimmeh, umannu — rav anan bar chiyyay, ashsharnohi vekayyemnohi kedachaze?

Amar leh: hahu shetara deyatme hava, vechash shemuel levet din toin. usevar shemuel dilma ikka disvira leh: halacha kerabbi mechavero velo mechaverav, uveha afillu mechaverav, sevar: eeved ravvcha ki hechi dela mafsedi yatme.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ed vedayyayn mitztarfin.
Amar rame bar chama: kamma mealleya ha shemata! amar rava: may mealleyuta? may deka mashed sahada la ka mashed dayyayna, umay deka mashed dayyayna la ka mashed sahada!
Ella ki ata rame bar yechezkel, amar: la tetzitinhu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh dishmuel.
b: Ikkela ravnay achu derabbi chiyyay bar abba lemizban shumeshme vaamar: hachi amar shemuel: ed vedayyayn mitztarfin. amar ammemar: kamma mealleya ha shemata! amar leh rav ashe leammemar: mishshum dekallesa avu deimmach, at name mekallesat la?! kevar parcha rava.

Amar rav safra amar rabbi abba amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta amar rav huna, veamri leh amar rav huna amar rav: shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar, shenayim makkirin chatimut yede edim, veechad eno makkir. ad shello chatmu — meidin befanav vechotem. mishshechatmu — en meidin befanav vechotem.
Umi katvinan? vehaamar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: hay ashsharta dedayyayne denichtav mikkammeh denaychvo sahadi achatimat yedayyhu — pesula, demitchaze keshikra, hacha name mitchaze keshikra!
Ella ema: ad shello katvu — meidin befanav vechotem, mishshekkatvu — en meidin befanav vechotem.

Shema minna telat. shema minna: ed naase dayyayn, ushema minna: dayyaynin hammakkirin chatimut yede edim — enan tzerichin lehaid bifnehem, ushema minna: dayyaynin sheen makkirin chatimut yede edim — tzerichin lehaid bifne kol echad veechad.

Matkef la rav ashe: bishlama ed naase dayyayn, shaminan minna, ella dayyaynin hammakkirin chatimut yede edim en tzerichin lehaid bifnehem — dilma leolam ema lach: tzerichin, veshane hacha deka mikkayyma haggada bechad.
Vedayyaynin sheen makkirin chatimut yede edim tzerichin lehaid bifne kol echad veechad, dilma leolam ema lach: en tzerichin, veshane hacha dela ka mikkayyma haggada kelal.

Yetev rabbi abba vekaamar la leha shemata deed naase dayyayn, etiveh rav safra lerabbi abba: rauhu shelosha, vehen bet din — yaamdu shenayim veyoshivu mechavrehem etzel hayyachid, veyaidu bifnehem, veyomru: "mekuddash hachodesh, mekuddash". sheen hayyachid neeman al yede atzmo. vei salka datach deed naase dayyayn, lema li kulle hay? letvu beduchetayyhu velikkaddeshu!

Amar leh: af ledidi kashya li, usheelteh lerav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta, verav yitzchak lerav huna, verav huna lechiyyay bar rav, vechiyyay bar rav lerav, vaamar lehu: hannach leedut hachodesh deorayyta, vekiyyum shetarot derabbanan.
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar, vekara arar al echad mehen. ad shello chatmu — meidin alav vechotem. mishshechatmu — en meidin alav vechotem.
Arar demay? i arar degazlanuta —

a: Tere utere ninhu. i arar difgam mishpacha, gilluy milleta bealma hu. leolam ema lach arar degazlanuta, vekaamri hane: yadinan beh daavad teshuva.

Amar rabbi zera: ha milleta merabbi abba shemia li, vei lav rabbi abba demin akko, shechachta: shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar umet echad mehem — tzerichin lemichtav: "bemotav telata havena, vechad letohi".

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vei ketav beh: shetara denan nefak likdamana be dina — tu la tzerich. vedilma bet din chatzuf hu, uchedishmuel. deamar shemuel: shenayim sheddanu, dinehem din, ella shennikra bet din chatzuf.
Dichtiv beh: "be dina derabbana ashe". vedilma rabbanan deve rav ashe kedishmuel sevira lehu! dichtiv beh: "veamar lana rabbana ashe".

Mishna haishsha sheamra: "eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani" — neemenet. shehappe sheasar, hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shehayta eshet ish, vehi omeret: "gerusha ani", enah neemenet. amra: "nishbeti, utehora ani" — neemenet. shehappe sheasar, hu happe shehittir. veim yesh edim shennishbet, vehi omeret: "tehora ani" — enah neemenet. veim mishshennisset bau edim — hare zo lo tetze.
Gemara amar rav assi: minnayin lehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir min hattora? shenneemar: "et bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha". "laish" — asra, "hazze" — hittira.

Lema li kera? sevara hi: hu asra, vehu share la! ella ki itzterich kera, lechidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin laav shenneeman leesor et bitto min hattora, shenneemar: "et bitti natatti laish". "hazze" lema li?
Mibbee leh lechidtane rabbi yona. detane rabbi yona: "et bitti natatti laish hazze". "hazze" — velo layyavam.

Tanu rabbanan: haishsha sheamra "eshet ish ani", vechazra veamra "penuya ani" — neemenet. veha shavvevya lenafsha chaticha deissura? amar rava bar rav huna: kegon shennatna ammatla lidvareha. tanya name hachi: amra eshet ish ani, vechazra veamra: penuya ani — enah neemenet. veim natna ammatla lidvareha — neemenet.

Umaase name beishsha achat gedola shehayta gedola benoy, vekaftzu aleha bene adam lekaddeshah. veamra lahem: "mekuddeshet ani". leyamim amda vekiddesha et atzmah. amru lah chachamim: ma rait laasot ken? amra lahem: battechilla shebbau alay anashim sheenam mehugganim, amarti: "mekuddeshet ani", achshav shebbau alay anashim mehugganim, amadti vekiddashti et atzmi. vezo halacha heela rav acha sar habbira lifne chachamim beusha, veamru: im natna ammatla lidvareha — neemenet.
Bea minneh shemuel merav: amra "temea ani", vechazra veamra "tehora ani", mahu? amar leh: af bezo, im natna
b: Ammatla lidvareha — neemenet. tena minneh arbaim zimnin, vaafillu hachi la avad shemuel ovada benafsheh.

Tanu rabbanan: shenayim omrim "met", ushenayim omrim "lo met". shenayim omrim "nitgarsha", ushenayim omrim "lo nitgarsha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — lo tetze. rabbi menachem bar yose omer: tetze. amar rabbi menachem bar yose: ematay ani omer tetze, bizman shebbau edim, veachar kach nisset. aval nisset veachar kach bau edim — lo tetze.
Mikkede tere utere ninhu, habba aleha beasham taluy kae! amar rav sheshet: kegon shennisset leechad meedeha. hi gufa beasham taluy kayyma! beomeret: "bari li".

Amar rabbi yochanan, shenayim omrim: "met", ushenayim omrim: "lo met" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — lo tetze. shenayim omrim "nitgarsha", ushenayim omrim "lo nitgarsha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — tetze.

May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar abbaye: targema beed echad. ed echad omer "met", hemnuhu rabbanan keve tere, vechidulla. deamar ulla: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hare kan shenayim, vehay dekaamar "lo met" — have leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
I hachi, afillu lechattechilla name! mishshum derav assi. deamar rav assi: "haser mimmecha ikkeshut pe ulezut sefatayim harechek mimmekka".
Sefa, ed echad omer "nitgarsha", veed echad omer "lo nitgarsha", tarvayyhu beeshet ish kamashadi. vehay dekaamar nitgarsha — have leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Rava amar: leolam tere utere ninhu. veraa rabbi yochanan devarav shel rabbi menachem bar yose begerushin, velo raa bemita. may tama? mita — enah yechola machchashto, gerushin — yechola machchashto.

Umi chatzifa kulle hay? vehaamar rav hamenuna: haishsha sheamra levalah "gerashtani" — neemenet. chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah! hane mille hecha delekka edim deka mesayyeyi la, aval hecha deikka edim deka mesayyeyi la — meizza umeizza.
Rav assi amar: kegon deamri edim "achshav met", "achshav gershah". mita lekka levarura. gerushin ikka levarura, deamrinan lah: im ita dehachi hava, achazi lan gittich.

Tanu rabbanan: shenayim omrim "nitkaddesha", ushenayim omrim "lo nitkaddesha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset lo tetze. shenayim omrim "nitgarsha", ushenayim omrim "lo nitgarsha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — tetze.

a: May shena resha, umay shena sefa?

Amar abbaye, targema beed echad: ed echad omer "nitkaddesha", veed echad omer "lo nitkaddesha" — tarvayyhu bifnuya kamashadi, vehay dekaamar "nitkaddesha" — hava leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Sefa, ed echad omer "nitgarsha", veed echad omer "lo nitgarsha" — tarvayyhu beeshet ish kamashadi, vehay dekaamar "nitgarsha" — have leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Rav ashe amar: leolam tere utere, veefoch: shenayim omrim "reinuha shennitkaddesha", ushenayim omrim "lo reinuha shennitkaddesha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — tetze.
Peshita: "lo reinuha" enah reaya! la tzericha, dedayyri bechatzer echad. mahu detema: im ita denitkaddesha — kala it la lemilleta. ka mashma lan deavdi inashe dimkaddeshi betzina.

Sefa: shenayim omrim "reinuha shennitgarsha", ushenayim omrim "lo reinuha shennitgarsha" — hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset — lo tetze. may ka mashma lan? af al gav dedayyri bechatzer echad — hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: gabbe kiddushin hu daavidi inashe dimkaddeshi betzina, aval gabbe gerushin, im ita deiggarsha — kala it la lemilleta, ka mashma lan daavidi inashe dimkaddeshi vedimgarshi betzina.
Veim mishshennisset bau edim lo tetze kulei. rabbi oshaya matne la aresha, rabba bar avin matne la assefa.
Man dematne la aresha — kol shekken assefa, devishvuya hekellu. uman dematne la assefa, aval aresha — la.
Lema bidrav hamenuna kamippalgi. deman dematne la aresha, it leh derav hamenuna. uman dematne la assefa, let leh derav hamenuna.
La, dechulle alma it lehu derav hamenuna. vehacha beha kamippalgi, demar savar: ki ittemar derav hamenuna befanav, aval shello befanav — meizza. umar savar: shello befanav name enah meizza.
Veim mishshennisset bau edim vechulei. amar avu dishmuel: lo "nisset" nisset mammash, ella kevan shehittiruha linnase — af al pi shello nisset. veha "lo tetze" katane! lo tetze mehetterah harishon.

Tanu rabbanan, amra: "nishbeti utehora ani veyesh li edim shettehora ani", en omrim: namtin ad sheyyavou edim, ella mattirin otah miyyad. hittiruha linnase veachar kach bau edim, veamru: lo yadanu — hare zo lo tetze. veim bau ede tumea, afillu yesh lah kamma banim — tetze.
Hane shevuyayta deatyayn linhardea. otev avu dishmuel natore bahadayyhu, amar leh shemuel: vead haiddana man natrinhu? amar leh: illu benatach havvyan, mi havet mezalzel behu kulle hay?

Havay "kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit", veishtavyayn benateh demar shemuel, veassekinhu leara deyisrael. okman leshavoyinhi meabbaray, veayyli [inhi] leve midresha derabbi chanina. ha amara: "nishbeti utehora ani", veha amara: "nishbeti utehora ani" — sherinhu.
Sof ul ato shavoyinhu. amar rabbi chanina: benan demoryayn innun. iggallay milleta divnateh demar shemuel havevyan.

Amar leh rabbi chanina lerav shemen bar abba: pok ittappal bekarivataych. amar leh lerabbi chanina: vehaikka edim bimdinat hayyam! hasheta mihat letanhu kamman. edim betzad istan, veteaser? tama dela ato edim, ha ato edim, mittasra?
Vehaamar avu dishmuel: kevan shehittiruha linnase, af al pi shello nisset! amar rav ashe: ede tumea ittemar.
b: Mishna shete nashim shennishbu, zot omeret "nishbeti utehora ani", vezot omeret "nishbeti utehora ani" — enan neemanot. uvizman shehen meidot zo et zo — hare ellu neemanot.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ani temea vachaverti tehora" — neemenet. "ani tehora vachaverti temea" — enah neemenet. "ani vachaverti temea" — neemenet al atzmah, veenah neemenet al chavertah. "ani vachaverti tehora" — neemenet al chavertah, veenah neemenet al atzmah.
Amar mar: "ani tehora vachaverti temea" — enah neemenet. hechi dame? i delekka edim, al atzmah ammay la mehemna? "nishbeti utehora ani" kaamra! ella peshita deikka edim.
Ema metziata: "ani vachaverti temea" — neemenet al atzmah, veenah neemenet al chavertah. vei deikka edim — ammay la mehemna? ella peshita delekka edim.
Ema sefa: "ani vachaverti tehora" — neemenet al chavertah, veenah neemenet al atzmah. vei delekka edim — aatzmah ammay la mehemna? ella peshita deikka edim.
Resha vesefa deikka edim, metziata delekka edim! amar abbaye: in. resha vesefa — deikka edim, metziata — delekka edim.

Rav pappa amar: kullah deikka edim, veikka ed echad deka afech. amra: "ani temea vachaverti tehora", veamar la ed echad: "at tehora vachavertech temea". ihi shavvita lenafsha chaticha deissura, chavertah mishtarya appumma dida.
"Ani tehora vachaverti temea", veamar lah ed echad: "at temea vachavertecha tehora". ihi, kevan deikka edim — lav kol kemina, chaverta — mishtarya appumma deed.
"Ani vachaverti temea", veamar la ed echad: "at vachavertech tehora" — ihi shavvita lenafsha chaticha deissura, chaverta mishtarya appumma deed. ha tu lema li? hayeynu resha!
Mahu detema: hane tarvayyhu tehorot ninhu, vehay dekaamra hachi, "tamot nafshi im pelishtim" hi deka avda — ka mashma lan.
"Ani vachaverti tehora", veamar lah ed echad: "at vachavertech temea", ihi kevan deikka edim — lav kol keminna. chaverta mishtarya appumma dida. ha tu lema li? hayeynu resha deresha!
Mahu detema: ki mehemna — bemakom defasla nafsha, aval bemakom demachshera nafsha — ema la mehemna, ka mashma lan.

Mishna vechen shene anashim, ze omer "kohen ani", veze omer "kohen ani" — enan neemanin. uvizman shehen meidin ze et ze — hare ellu neemanin. rabbi yehuda omer: en maalin lichhunna al pi ed echad. amar rabbi elazar: ematay — bimkom sheyyesh orrin. aval bimkom sheen orrin — maalin lichhunna al pi ed echad. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan: maalin lichhunna al pi ed echad.
Gemara kol hane lema li! tzerichi, dei tena mode rabbi yehoshua, mishshum deikka derara demamona. aval edim, delekka derara demamona — ema la.
Vei tena edim, mishshum dilalma, aval ihu, dilnafsheh,

a: Ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte, mishshum demamona, aval eshet ish, deissura — ema la.
"Nishbeti utehora ani" lema li? mishshum deka bae lemitne: "veim mishshennisset bau edim — hare zo lo tetze".
Hanicha leman dematne la assefa, ella leman dematne la aresha — may ikka lememar? mishshum deka bae lemitne: "shete nashim shennishbu".
Ushete nashim shennishbu" lema li? mahu detema nechush legomlin, kamashma lan.
"Vechen shene anashim" lema li? mishshum deka bae lemitne pelugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan.
