Tanu rabbanan: "ani kohen vachaveri kohen" — neeman lehaachilo bitruma, veeno neeman lehassio ishsha ad sheyyehu shelosha: shenayim meidin al ze, ushenayim meidin al ze. rabbi yehuda omer: af eno neeman lehaachilo bitruma ad sheyyehu shelosha, shenayim meidin al ze ushenayim meidin al ze.

Lememra derabbi yehuda chayesh legomlin, verabbanan la chayyshi legomlin? veha ippecha shaminan lehu, ditnan: hachammarin shennichnesu lair, veamar echad mehen: shelli chadash, veshel chaveri yashan: shelli eno metukkan, veshel chaveri metukkan — eno neeman. rabbi yehuda omer: neeman.
Amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: muchelefet hashshita. abbaye amar: leolam la tefoch. bidmay hekellu, rov amme haaretz measserin hen.

Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya? ella: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya, kidshannenan. derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya, kidamar rabbi chama bar ukeva, beshekkele ummanuto beyado,
b: Hacha name beshekkele ummanuto beyado.
Vehecha ittemar derabbi chama bar ukeva — aha, ditnan: hakkaddar shehinniach kederotav veyarad lishtot (mayim min hayeor) — happenimiyyot tehorot, vehachitzonot temeot.
Vehatanya: ellu vaellu temeot! amar rabbi chama bar ukeva: beshekkele ummanuto beyado, mippene sheyyad hakkol memashmeshet bahen.
Vehatanya: ellu vaellu tehorot! amar rabbi chama bar ukeva: besheen kele ummanuto beyado.
Veella ha ditnan: happenimiyyot tehorot vehachitzonot temeot, hechi mashkachat la?
Dismicha lirshut harabbim, umishshum chippufe reshut harabbim.
Veibbaet ema: rabbi yehuda verabbanan bemaalin mitteruma leyuchasin kamippalgi.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehaalot mishshetarot leyuchasin? hechi dame: illema dichtiv beh "ani peloni kohen chatamti ed" — man ka mashed illaveh?

La tzericha, dichtiv beh: "ani peloni kohen laviti mane mippeloni" vachatimu sahadi, may? ammane shebbashshetar ka mashadi, o dilma akkulla milleta ka mashadi. rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: maalin, vechad amar: en maalin.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehaalot minnesiut kappayim leyuchasin? tibbee leman deamar maalin mitteruma leyuchasin, vetibbee leman deamar en maalin.
Tibbee leman deamar maalin: hane mille teruma, daavon mita hi. aval nesiut kappayim, deissur ase — la. o dilma la shena.
Tibbee leman deamar en maalin: hane mille teruma demitachla betzina, aval nesiut kappayim, divfarhesya — i lav kohen hu, kulle hay la machtzif inash nafsheh. o dilma la shena.

Rav chisda verabbi avina, chad amar: maalin, vechad amar: en maalin. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: mahu lehaalot minnesiut kappayim leyuchasin? amar leh: pelugeta derav chisda verabbi avina.

Hilcheta may? amar leh: ana matnita yadana. detanya, rabbi yose omer: gedola chazaka. shenneemar: "umibbene hakkohanim bene chovayya bene hakkotz bene varzillay asher lakach mibbenot barzillay haggiladi ishsha vayyikkare al shemam. elle bikshu chetavam hammityachsim velo nimtzau vaygoalu min hakkehunna. vayyomer hattirshata lahem asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim ad amod kohen leurim vetummim".

Amar lahem: hare attem bechezkatchem. bamme heyitem ochlim baggola — bekodshe haggevul, af kan bekodshe haggevul. vei salka datach maalin minnesiut kappayim leyuchasin, hane kevan defarsi yedayyhu — ate leassokinhu!
Shane hacha deria chezkayyhu. dei la tema hachi, leman deamar maalin mitteruma leyuchasin: kevan deachli bitruma ate leassokinhu! ella lav, mishshum deria chezkayyhu.

a: Veella, may gedola chazaka? meikkara achul bitruma derabbanan, hasheta achul bitruma deorayyta.

Vei baet ema: hasheta name bitruma derabbanan achul, bitruma deorayyta la achul. vechi massekinan mitteruma leyuchasin — bitruma deorayyta, bitruma derabbanan — la massekinan. veella, may gedola chazaka? deaf al gav deikka lemigzar mishshum teruma deorayyta — la gazrinan.
Uvatteruma deorayyta la achul? veha ketiv: "asher lo yochlu mikkodesh hakkodashim". mikkodesh hakkodashim hu dela achul, ha bitruma deorayyta achul!

Hachi kaamar: la bemidde deikkeri "kodesh", dichtiv: "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh", vela bemidde deikkeri "kadashim", dichtiv: "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel", veamar mar: bemuram min hakkodashim — lo tochel.
Ta shema: chazaka lichhunna — nesiut kappayim bevavel, vaachilat challa besureya, vechilluk mattanot bichrakkin. katane mihat nesiut kappayim, may lav leyuchasin? la, litruma.

Veha dumeya daachilat challa katane, ma achilat challa leyuchasin — af nesiut kappayim leyuchasin! la, achilat challa gufa litruma. kasavar challa bizman hazze derabbanan, uteruma deorayyta. umassekinan mechalla derabbanan litruma deorayyta. vechidafech lehu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerabbanan.
Ta shema: chazaka lichhunna — nesiut kappayim vechilluk goranot beeretz yisrael. uvesureya, uvechol makom sheshsheluche rosh chodesh maggiin — nesiut kappayim reaya, aval lo chilluk goranot.
Uvavel kesureya. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af alekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim barishona, mippene shebbet din kevuin sham.

Katane mihat nesiut kappayim, may lav leyuchasin? la, lechalla. ha dumeya dechilluk goranot katane: ma chilluk goranot leyuchasin, af nesiut kappayim leyuchasin! la, chilluk goranot gufe lechalla. kasavar teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan, vechalla deorayyta. umassekinan mitteruma derabbanan lechalla deorayyta.

Vechidashkechinhu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerabbanan. deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan beve rav, deyatvi vekaamri: afillu leman deamar teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan, challa deorayyta. shehare sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku — nitchayyeyvu bechalla, velo nitchayyeyvu bitruma.

Veamena lehu ana: adderabba, afillu leman deamar teruma bizman hazze deorayyta — challa derabbanan. detanya: "bevoachem el haaretz". i "bevoachem", yachol mishshennichnesu lah shenayim ushelosha meraggelim — talmud lomar: "bevoachem". beviat kullechem amarti, velo beviat miktzatchem. vechi assekinhu ezra,
b: Lav kullehu seluk.

Ta shema: chazaka lichhunna — nesiut kappayim vechilluk goranot veedut. edut chazaka hi? ella lav, hachi kaamar: nesiut kappayim ki edut: ma edut leyuchasin, af nesiut kappayim leyuchasin! la: edut habbaa mikkoach chazaka — kachazakah.

Ki hahu daata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: muchezkani baze shehu kohen. amar leh: ma raita? amar leh: shekkara rishon bevet hakkeneset. bechezkat shehu kohen, o bechezkat shehu gadol? shekkara acharav levi. veheelahu rabbi amme lichhunna al piv.

Hahu daata lekammeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar leh: muchezkani baze shehu levi. amar leh: ma raita? amar leh: shekkara sheni bevet hakkeneset. bechezkat shehu levi, o bechezkat shehu gadol? shekkara lefanav kohen. vehaalehu rabbi yehoshua ben levi lilviyya al piv.

Hahu daata lekammeh deresh lakish, amar leh: muchezkani baze shehu kohen. amar leh: ma raita? [amar leh] shekkara rishon bevet hakkeneset. amar leh: reitiv shechillek al haggoranot? amar lo rabbi elazar: veim en sham goren, batla kehunna?

Zimnin havu yatvi kammeh derabbi yochanan, ata ki ha maase lekammeh. amar leh resh lakish: reitiv shechillek al haggoren? amar leh rabbi yochanan: veim en sham goren, batla kehunna? hadar chazyeh lerabbi elazar bishut, amar: shamat mille devar nappacha, vela amart lan mishshemeh?
Rabbi verabbi chiyyay, chad heela ben al pi aviv lichhunna, vechad heela ach al pi achiv lilviyya.

Tistayyem derabbi heela ben al pi aviv lichhunna, detanya: hare shebba veamar: beni ze, vechohen hu — neeman lehaachilo bitruma, veeno neeman lehassio ishsha, divre rabbi. amar lo rabbi chiyyay: im atta maamino lehaachilo bitruma — taamino lehassio ishsha. veim i atta maamino lehassio ishsha — lo taamino leechol bitruma!

Amar lo: ani maamino lehaachilo bitruma — shebbeyado lehaachilo bitruma, veeni maamino lehassio ishsha — sheen beyado lehassio ishsha. tistayyem. umidderabbi heela ben al pi aviv lichhunna — rabbi chiyyay heela ach al pi achiv lilviyya.
Verabbi chiyyay, may shena ben dela, dekarov hu etzel aviv — ach name karov hu etzel achiv?!

a: Bemesiach lefi tummo. ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase beadam echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo, veamar: zechurani kesheani tinok umurekav al ketefo shel abba, vehotziuni mibbet hassefer, vehifshituni et kuttonti, vehatebiluni leechol bitruma laerev.
Verabbi chiyyay mesayyem ba: vachaveray bedelin mimmenni, vehayu korin oti "yochanan ochel challot". veheelahu rabbi lichhunna al piv.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: keshem shetteruma chazaka lichhunna — kach maaser rishon chazaka lichhunna, vehacholek bevet din enah chazaka.

Maaser rishon delevi hu! kerabbi elazar ben azarya. detanya: teruma lechohen, maaser rishon lelevi, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: maaser rishon af lechohen. emor deamar rabbi elazar ben azarya "af lechohen", lechohen velo lelevi mi amar?

In, batar dekansinhu ezra. vedilma ikkeru veyahavu leh! amar rav chisda: hacha bemay askinan — kegon demuchezak lan baavu dehay dechohen hu, unefak aleh kala deven gerusha uven chalutza hu, vachalaku leh ledideh maaser bevet haggoranot.

Levi, delav levi hu, may ikka lememar — ben gerusha o ben chalutza hu. la mibbaya leman deamar maaser rishon asur lezarim, dela havo yahavi leh. ella afillu leman deamar maaser rishon muttar lezarim, hane mille lemispa lehu, aval betorat chalukka la yahavi leh.
Vehacholek bevet din enah chazaka. i bevet din la havya chazaka, hecha havya chazaka?! amar rav sheshet, hachi kaamar: hacholek teruma benichse aviv im echav bevet din — enah chazaka.
Peshita! mahu detema: middehanach laachila, hay name laachila, ka mashma lan: hanach laachila, hay lezabbone.

Rabbi yehuda omer: en maalin lichhunna al pi ed echad vechulei. rabban shimon ben gamliel hayeynu rabbi eliezer! vechi tema arar chad ikka benayyhu, derabbi eliezer savar arar chad, verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: arar tere. haamar rabbi yochanan: divre hakkol, en arar pachot mishshenayim!
Ella: hacha bemay askinan — demuchezak lan baavu dehay dechohen hu, unefak aleh kala deven gerusha o ben chalutza hu, veachatinneh. vaata ed echad veamar: yadana beh dechohen hu,
b: Veassekinneh. vaato be tere veamri: ben gerusha uven chalutza hu, veachatinneh. vaata ed echad veamar: yadana beh dechohen hu. udechulle alma mitztarfin leedut.

Vehacha bemechash leziluta deve dina kamippalgi. tanna kamma savar: kevan deachatinneh, la massekinan leh, chayyshinan leziluta deve dina. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: anan achatinan leh vaanan massekinan leh, uleziluta deve dina la chayyshinan.
Matkef la rav ashe: i hachi, afillu tere utere name!

Ella amar rav ashe: bemitztarfin leedut kamippalgi, uviflugeta dehane tannae. detanya: en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad. rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: afillu baze achar ze. veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehem keechad.
Rabbi natan omer: shomin devarav shel ze hayyom, uchesheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin devarav.
Mishna haishsha shennechbesha bide goyim, al yede mamon — mutteret levalah. al yede nefashot — asura levalah.
Gemara amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: lo shanu ella sheyyad yisrael takkifa al ummot haolam, aval yad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman, afillu al yede mamon — asura levalah.

Metiv rava: heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ben hakkatztzav al bat yisrael shehurehana beashkelon, verichakuha bene mishpachtah, veedeha meidim otah shello nistera veshello nitmaa. veamru lahem chachamim: im attem maaminim shehurehana — haaminu shello nistera veshello nitmaa, veim i attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmaa — al taaminu shehurehana.
Veha ashkelon, deyad ummot haolam takkifa al atzman, vekatane:
